name: Hyundai Mitja Marató Barcelona by Brooks
summary: The Barcelona Half Marathon (Mitja Marató de Barcelona) is a fully urban race through the heart and coast of the city. Barcelona's tourism site calls it flat, fast and monumental. A men's world record of 56:42 was set here in 2025.
courseHighlights: Start at Passeig Picasso, near Parc de la Ciutadella
Passeig de Colom and the old port area
Paral·lel and Gran Via through the Eixample
Diagonal toward the Besòs river and Fòrum
Finish on Passeig Pujades, near Port Olímpic and the beach

paceStrategy.summary: The course is described as flat and fast, so aim for an even pace. The race uses staggered starts based on your expected pace, so line up in your own group and avoid starting too fast.

segments.terrain: Flat city streets from Passeig Picasso to the port area
segments.advice: Run at goal pace or slightly slower and avoid weaving.

segments.terrain: Flat avenues: Paral·lel, Gran Via and Diagonal
segments.advice: Hold an even pace and drink at the stations.

segments.terrain: Flat coastal road toward Port Olímpic
segments.advice: Keep steady and speed up only in the final 2 km.

fuelingNotes: No aid-station positions were found on the pages we checked. Check the current race guide and carry your own gels.
tips: Line up in the start group that matches the pace you gave when you registered
Pace groups run from 1:20 to 2:05, so pick one that matches your goal
Check the current race guide for the exact route, because details can change from year to year
Dress for a cool February morning and plan a warm layer for the wait

faq.question: Is the Barcelona Half Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Yes. Barcelona's tourism site calls it a flat, fast and monumental half marathon. We found no official climb figure.

faq.question: Where does the Barcelona Half Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at Passeig Picasso and finishes on Passeig Pujades, near Parc de la Ciutadella.

faq.question: When is the Barcelona Half Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in February.
